thesis: The market regime is risk-off (VIX percentile 0.981, QQQ below both averages), and buying a stock 4% under a 52-week high that was already rejected on 11/6 is poor timing. Reward/risk to the 31.00 high is only about 1.2, and the headline 1.94 needs a clean breakout in a tape that is breaking down. Sell-side consensus is 'Reduce' with a mean target of 24.5, well below the 29.70 close, and the CFO sold near 30. The +5.1% bounce on 11/23 has no identified news driver and came on average volume with no accumulation, so it looks like a counter-trend bounce that can fade. A 21.7% short float cuts both ways, but in risk-off tape it also signals informed skepticism.
